integrity.computation_role: Exact finite-dimensional regression checks only; not an infinite proof.

scientific_limitations: The invariant finite-state system is the co-moving binary diagonal-Laplacian corner; it does not describe whole-lattice periodic return.
Ternary corner rules, mixed modulus schedules, and Hamming-weight constrained seed counts are not classified.
Novelty is the explicit moving-corner cycle census, not the underlying classical tensor-product kernel lemma; historical priority is not conclusively resolved.
title: Exact cycle census for binary Laplacian moving corners on arbitrary rectangles
